title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G079 G080 G081 G082 G083
note: Five-case regression batch covering inclusive date filtering, descriptive projection, non-cancelled order attributes, product attributes and ordering, and customer names with grouped order counts.

cases.question: Find completed orders placed between June 3 and June 12, 2025 inclusive.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-06-03' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-13' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: List Indian customers who signed up after April 1, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, country, signup_date FROM customers WHERE country = 'India' AND signup_date > DATE '2025-04-01' ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: Find non-cancelled orders placed after June 5, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND order_date > DATE '2025-06-05' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: Show Electronics or Audio products priced below 500.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, price FROM products WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Audio') AND price < 500 ORDER BY price, product_name;

cases.question: Find customers with at least two orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 2 ORDER BY c.customer_name;
